entities.name: Kōsaku Matsumora
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kosaku Matsumora  was a Ryūkyūan karate master. He studied Tomari-te under Karyu Uku and Kishin Teruya. He also studied Jigen-ryu. Among Matsumora's students, who went on to influence new generations through students of their own, were Choki Motobu and Chotoku Kyan.
